summary: @ornikar/renovate-config preinstall executes bundled obfuscated payload via Bun runtime
details: The package advertises itself as a Renovate JSON configuration but its package.json preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (or uses an already-installed bun on PATH) and invokes it against a bundled 727KB single-line, string-array-obfuscated sibling file math_init.js (custom rotating-shift decoder, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). Execution is unconditional at install time via execFileSync. The obfuscated payload's internals are opaque and cannot be inspected as source. A Renovate config package has no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate language runtime and hand it an opaque blob at install; the Node-visible dropper delegates execution to Bun specifically to evade scanners that inspect only Node-reachable code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
